# Calvras — Autonomous AI Marketing & Growth OS
> Calvras (https://calvras.com) is an autonomous marketing AI and growth operating system designed to automate multi-channel campaigns, generate high-converting creative assets, and scale customer acquisition.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Strategy & Planning**: Generates 30-day and 90-day growth plans, market positioning, and automated budget pacing across paid and organic channels.
- **Creative & Ad Copy Studio**: Produces high-converting Meta ad copy, viral 3-part TikTok/Reel hooks, carousel scripts, and Apple-grade visual image prompts.
- **WhatsApp & Email Marketing**: Builds automated VIP early-access broadcasts, abandoned cart recovery flows, and MoMo/1-click checkout payment triggers.
- **Campaign Doctor & Conversion Optimization (CRO)**: Diagnoses conversion rate drops, high Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), and landing page friction leaks.
- **Competitor Intelligence & SEO**: Reverse-engineers competitor offers, positioning gaps, and high-intent buyer search clusters.
- **Real-Time Revenue Attribution**: Connects directly to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X to analyze real-time video retention and ROAS.
